Name: DE-Brands
Statement:
select  cli.Id as ClientId,
        cli.Name as Client,
        brd.Oid as BrandId,
        brd.Name as Brand,
        brd.ModifiedOn
from    Brand brd
            join ClientLookup cli on cli.Id = brd.CommercialClient
where   (@ModifiedFrom is null or brd.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom)
